text: For a Kerr black hole to have an event horizon rather than a naked ring singularity, the book requires the spin to satisfy a ≤ GM/c², equivalently the angular-momentum bound |J| ≤ ___.
explanation: Horizons exist only where Δ = r² − r_s r + a² = 0 has real roots, which requires a ≤ GM/c². Since a = J/(Mc), this is the extremal bound |J| ≤ GM²/c; at equality (extremal Kerr) the inner and outer horizons merge at r_+ = r_- = GM/c², and beyond it the ring singularity would be naked.
